headline.text: The FDA label lists atazanavir with alfuzosin as contraindicated because of hypotension risk.

reported.text: The label explicitly names both drugs in the hypotension warning.

claims.text: The FDA atazanavir label lists alfuzosin coadministration as contraindicated because of hypotension risk.
claims.quote: Coadministration of atazanavir with alfuzosin is contraindicated due to risk for hypotension [see Contraindications (4) ].
claims.judgeRationale: The atazanavir label states coadministration with alfuzosin is contraindicated due to hypotension risk.

sources.title: New drugs of 2003.
sources.citation: 1544-3191 44 2 2004 Mar-Apr Journal of the American Pharmacists Association : JAPhA J Am Pharm Assoc (2003)

pharmacistQuestions.text: The label describes this interaction, but there seem to be no human studies of it. How is it usually handled for someone like me?
Do any of my other medicines contain Alfuzosin or Atazanavir, or work the same way?
Does my dose, or the time between taking Alfuzosin and Atazanavir, change how much this matters?

gaps.text: The packet contains no human study quantifying hypotension risk for this combination.
